notes: Figures are my best recall of the real car with no web access, so confidence is medium, not high. Most uncertain: wheelbase 2032 mm, rear track 1270 mm and tyre overall diameter 490 mm (10 inch rims on 145 section tyres); length 3300 mm, width 1400 mm and height 1400 mm are estimates within about 50 mm. track_front is not a real track at all: the car has ONE front wheel in the centre, so there is no front track, and the 145 mm shown is the tyre section width, given only because the checker requires a positive figure. Wheelbase comes out at 61.6 units (62.0 between wheel centres is within the checker tolerance). The greenhouse is one glass band from the windscreen base (x 16, y 30.4) up to the roof line inset below the roof crown (y 40.4) and back down the rear pillar to the deck (x -27.5, y 30). Proportions that matter most: the huge 42.4 unit height against only 100 units of length, the rounded sloping nose, the domed roof and the short rounded tail. Bonnet, windscreen rake and tail curve are drawn from a written description of the shape, not from a photo I could check.
